title: feat(metadata-core)!: a knowledge source is saved only on a deployment that mounts the knowledge service
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP
Fixes #37983

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md § Knowledge Sources (RAG) — the run-time clause now says that where an app ships no source, a run-time save is refused (`503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing written) until the stack declares `requires: ['knowledge']` and the server restarts (it said such items are never indexed); the matching eval case in `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json` expects the same; the token-ratchet row moves 6893 → 6906 under ruling record 6513306068, letter B

## 维护者速读

- 作者在没装知识服务的部署上,通过工作台、元数据接口或智能体工具保存知识源时,会当场失败并看到原因和修法(先在应用配置里声明需要知识服务并重启,再保存);以前这种保存显示成功却永远不生效。
- 属于知识库检索这条线,执行您选的方案 D:让作者在保存那一刻就知道,而不是只在看不到的服务器日志里。
- 只影响在这类部署上保存知识源的作者;在这类部署上复制一个含知识源的整个应用包也会被拒、什么都不复制(这是裁决点名的三处之外的第四处,请批准前读下方的待定问题一节);装包、种子数据、迁移照常通过;出问题可整单撤回。
- 要你做的:批准这次收窄(按审批流程)。

## What changes

Ruling D (maintainer, recorded on #37983, comment 7220511579) is implemented in the one predicate every save door asks, `authoredKnowledgeSourceRefusal` (`packages/metadata-core/src/knowledge-source-save-admission.ts`):

- **No knowledge service registered + a non-system writer ⇒ refused.** `resolveKnowledgeService()` answering `undefined` (or `null`) used to admit the save; it now answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with a message that names the item, the reason and the remedy in order: add `requires: ['knowledge']` to the stack (or, on a host that composes its own kernel, `KnowledgeServicePlugin` and a knowledge store), restart, then save the source again. Nothing is written.
- **Held as ruled:** the engine's own write (`isSystem`: package install, seed, migration) is never refused (the `isSystem` check still runs before the service is resolved); a REGISTERED knowledge service with no `admitAuthoredSource` (not the platform's, for example host-mounted) keeps today's accept. The module doc (`:33-34` on main) now says both, and gains a section on the no-service case.
- **Doors.** No door code changed shape: `PUT /meta/:type/:name` in `packages/rest` passes `refused.code` through for a non-403 (`SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`), the runtime dispatcher `PUT` derives `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` from `503`, and the MCP `save_metadata_draft` passes `refused.code` through for a non-403 (on `main` since #37306). Only their comments are updated. Each door is pinned.
- **Why `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`** (ADR-0112 status table, `STATUS_TO_STANDARD_CODE` in `packages/spec/src/api/errors.zod.ts`): the save needs a service this deployment does not run. It is the code this module already answers for a knowledge service that cannot be reached, and the code the knowledge service answers at index and search for a source whose store is not mounted (the same kind of composition fact). It is also the one code all three doors already carry without a door change. Rejected: `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` (the item is valid; a validation code sends the author to fix the item), `403` (not a permission), `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (the meta door's answer for a protocol with no `saveMetaItem`), `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and `428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` (no conflicting resource, no missing request precondition), and a new ledger code (a contract change the ruling did not make). The message carries the remedy and does not say "try again".
- **ADR-0087:** `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` owes a registered entry: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.knowledge-source-save-refused-without-knowledge-service.ts` (notice only, no D2 conversion: the fix is the deployment's composition, never the item). The changeset carries `registered` with that id.

## Boot line and docs (ruling items 2 and 4), landed after #37306

Held off this branch until #37306 merged (PR #38026, dbe07169); `main` is now merged in (1ca3a31db7) and the held commit is re-applied as 33acf12ec4.

- **Boot line** (`packages/objectql/src/knowledge-source-unserved.ts`): the line for `knowledge_source` items held with no knowledge service now names the same remedy as the save refusal, from the item-4 patch's `UNSERVED_REMEDY`: declare `requires: ['knowledge']` and restart (or, on a host that composes its own kernel, `KnowledgeServicePlugin` and a knowledge store). Before, it said "add `KnowledgeServicePlugin` and a knowledge adapter to the composition". Only the boot-line half of that patch was taken: #37306 did not touch this file, so `main` still carried the old text.
- **What #37306 changed, and what that changes here.** A source the app ships in `knowledgeSources` now mounts the service by itself, and `adapter` is optional. So a source saved at run time (Studio, the metadata API, MCP) is never one that mounts the service, and the remedy the maintainer ruled (`requires: ['knowledge']`, restart, then save) is still the one that fixes such a save. The refusal sentence is unchanged. The docs now also say that a source saved at run time does not mount the service. The boot-line module doc says that the items it names are ones the stack does not ship. Main's `knowledge-rag.mdx` already said "the token is for an app that ships none and authors its sources at run time", which matches.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ai/knowledge-rag.mdx`: a bullet beside "Without a source or the token", plus a clause on the run-time-authoring bullet. `content/docs/protocol/knowledge.mdx`: the boot-line paragraph names the remedy (it named the plugin and an adapter), and a paragraph under "Who may author one" covers the refusal, the duplicate and the holds. Rewritten against main's merged text, not patched blindly: `git am --3way` conflicted on `knowledge-rag.mdx`.
- **Changeset:** gains the `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/skills` patch lines and their bullets.
- The MCP draft door on `main` now passes `refused.code` through for a non-403 (#37306), so this refusal still arrives there as `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.

## Open question

The package **duplicate** door (`POST /packages/:id/duplicate`) asks the same predicate for each knowledge source it copies, so on a deployment with no knowledge service it now refuses a duplicate of a package that holds one, `503`, naming the remedy (pinned in `packages-knowledge-source-gate.test.ts`). The ruling names three doors; this is the fourth door that saves a source as the caller. Keeping it refused is the predicate's own reading and the ruling's principle (the copy would be kept and never served); carving it out needs a new input on an exported function. Recommendation: keep it.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata-core/src/knowledge-source-save-admission.test.ts`: refusal with code, status, the reason sentence and the ordered remedy, for both URL spellings and for `undefined`/`null`; an unnamed item; `isSystem` not refused and the service never resolved; a registered service without the member still admits.
- REST `PUT` (`packages/rest/src/meta-write-door-capability-enumeration.test.ts`): refused on the kernel's branded "never registered" miss and on a server with no kernel provider; system write saved; host-mounted service saved.
- Runtime dispatcher `PUT` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-save-capability-gate.test.ts`): refused on a real `ObjectKernel` with nothing registered; system write saved; host-mounted service saved.
- MCP `save_metadata_draft` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`): refused, nothing written, another type still saves; host-mounted service saved.
- Package duplicate (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-knowledge-source-gate.test.ts`): refused, nothing copied; a package with no source and the engine's own call copy as before.
- Boot line (`packages/objectql/src/knowledge-source-unserved.test.ts`): names `Declare requires: ['knowledge'] in the stack and restart`.

Head is now `5bc3ee1a00`. Since `33acf12ec4` it adds only: the test-harness fix `6e4a904ea1` (the MCP `knowledge_source` contract case from #38053 mounts an admitting knowledge service; comment 7232197442), the skills text, eval expectation, ratchet row and changeset line above, the module-doc wording at index and search, and two clean merges of `main` (the second carries #38091). The other pages match on the `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` literal only and say nothing about knowledge sources. The release-owned pages are not edited.
